Question: How long does delivery take?
Answer: Metro cities: 2 to 4 business days. All other areas: 4 to 7 business days. You see the expected date at checkout.

Question: Is delivery free?
Answer: Delivery is free on orders of Rs. 499 or more. Orders below Rs. 499 have a delivery fee of Rs. 49.

Question: Do you deliver outside India?
Answer: No. DemoKart delivers only to addresses in India.

Question: How do I track my order?
Answer: Go to My Orders and tap Track. Once your order ships, we also send a tracking link by SMS and email.

Question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
Answer: Yes, but only before the order ships. Go to My Orders, open the order and tap Change address.

Question: Which payment methods do you accept?
Answer: UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, DemoKart Wallet and Cash on Delivery.

Question: Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
Answer: Yes, on orders up to Rs. 10,000. Cash on Delivery has a fee of Rs. 30.

Question: How do I apply a coupon code?
Answer: At checkout, tap Apply coupon and enter the code. Only one coupon can be used per order.

Question: Is my payment information safe?
Answer: Yes. Payments go through a certified payment gateway, and DemoKart never stores your full card number.

Question: What is DemoKart Wallet?
Answer: DemoKart Wallet is your store balance. Refunds can go to it instantly, and you can use it to pay for any order.

Question: How do I cancel an order?
Answer: Before it ships: go to My Orders and tap Cancel. After it ships you cannot cancel, but you can refuse the delivery or return the item.

Question: Can I order without creating an account?
Answer: Yes, you can check out as a guest. To track a guest order, use your order ID and phone number on the Track Order page.

Question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
Answer: Yes. Gift wrapping costs Rs. 39 per item. Choose it at checkout.

Question: What is your return policy?
Answer: Most items can be returned within 10 days of delivery if they are unused and in their original packaging. Some items cannot be returned; see the Returns and Refunds Policy.

Question: How do I return an item?
Answer: Go to My Orders, open the order and tap Return. A courier picks the item up from your address within 2 to 3 business days.

Question: When will I get my refund?
Answer: After the returned item passes our quality check: UPI and DemoKart Wallet in 1 to 2 business days, cards and net banking in 5 to 7 business days.

Question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or colour?
Answer: Yes, for clothing and footwear, within 10 days of delivery. Each order can be exchanged once.

Question: My item arrived damaged. What should I do?
Answer: Report it within 48 hours of delivery: go to My Orders, tap Report a problem and add photos. We will send a replacement or give a full refund.

Question: I received the wrong item. What should I do?
Answer: Report it within 48 hours of delivery: go to My Orders, tap Report a problem and add a photo of what you received. We will collect it and send the right item.

Question: How do I contact customer support?
Answer: Chat with us in the app or on the website, 9 am to 9 pm every day. You can also email support@demokart.example.
